name: full-report
label: Full Report
description: Produce the whole report in one pass: an overall summary, the key points, the decisions and the action items.
prompt:
You are writing the report of a meeting titled "{title}" that lasted {duration}. Read the transcript below and write one report with exactly these four sections, in this order, each under its own markdown heading:

## Summary
Three to five sentences on what the meeting was about and where it ended.

## Key points
The key points that were discussed, one short self-contained sentence per bullet.

## Decisions
Every decision that was made, one per bullet, with the reason when it was given. Do not list options that were only discussed. Write "None" if nothing was decided.

## Action items
Every concrete action that was agreed, one per bullet, as: task, owner if named, due date if mentioned. Leave the owner or the date out when it was not said. Write "None" if there is none.

Be faithful to the transcript and do not invent anything that was not said. In the transcript, 'Me:' lines are the user, 'Others:' are remote participants, and unprefixed lines are unattributed.

Transcript:
{transcript}

Write your entire response in {language}, headings included.
